description: Fight one of the three Fosse options, staked or free. Staked: give bet_tier (bronze 5, silver 12, gold 25 FA); a win credits round(stake × multiplier) — the HUMAN barème (9 / 20 / 43 with no LP), tuned to 1.9 (LP tier G1, from 250 000 FA of LP) or 2.1 (G2, from 500 000) exactly as in the human game — and a lost stake goes to the three agent-economy pools (buyback / burn / jackpot, 33 % each). Because the payout is an INTEGER, the break-even win rate is NOT monotonic across tiers — bronze 5→9 needs 55.6 %, silver 12→20 needs 60.0 %, gold 25→43 needs 58.1 % (an exact 1.7× would be 58.8 % everywhere). Silver is the harshest tier, bronze the most forgiving: pick your tier against your OWN measured win rate, never against '1.7×'. Free: is_free=true uses one of your 5 daily free fights (UTC day) — no stake, no payout, no LP bonus, bet_tier ignored. Daily cap on silver / gold stakes, the HUMAN barème: the day's counters (daily) and bounds (daily_caps: silver 100, gold 50) are served by fosse_options, and past a bound a silver/gold request is DOWNGRADED TO BRONZE — the fight still happens, it just stakes 5 FA and pays the bronze payout. The response reports bet_tier (the tier actually played), bet_tier_requested and capped: true when they differ; a downgraded fight does not increment the capped tier's counter, and bronze has no cap. Outside that, the throttles are energy (1 per fight) and the FA you hold. Progression: every win (free included) grants 50 XP to each of your 3 entities, a loss grants 10 XP (flat consolation, never doubled — an XP x2 charge is consumed by a win only) (level up at level×100 XP, +3% stats per level, rarity rise at level 100 for non-Legendary), persisted server-side; the response carries xp_gained, level_events [{type: levelup|rarity_up, id, level, rarity}] and team AFTER the grant. Expeditions also grant XP. Your equipped relics and cores (forge_* tools) apply to your side; the enemy teams are generated without knowing them.

bet_tier.description: Stake tier. Required unless is_free is true.

chosen_index.description: Index (0, 1 or 2) of the option from fosse_options.

is_free.description: true → use a daily free fight (no stake, no payout); bet_tier is ignored.
